test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 30 Aug 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Which state was the theme state of the 35th Suraj Kund Craft Fair held in March-April 2022?
solution:
The correct answer is **__Jammu and Kashmir__**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The Union ministries of tourism, textiles, culture and external affairs work in partnership with the **Surajkund Mela **Authority and Haryana Tourism to celebrate the festival.
 
• The fair was started in **1987 **to support the pool of talented artisans who used indigenous technology but were suffering as a result of less expensive machine-made knockoffs.
 
• In **2013**, the fair was elevated to international level.
 
• **Surajkund Fair**, the world's largest crafts fair, highlights the extent and wealth of Indian handicrafts, handlooms and cultural heritage.
 
• For the year 2022, Uzbekistan will serve as the **“Partner Nation” **and Jammu and Kashmir will serve as the** “Theme State”.**​

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Surajkund Fair **2023** is the first of its kind international artisan fair that provides a platform to artists from across the world to showcase their skills and cultures.
 
• The fair, which is organized by the Haryana Tourism Department every year at Surajkund, offers a **variety of** unusual activities for visitors of all ages.
 
• To make this fair a huge success, active participation of more than 20 countries from **South Asia, Africa and Europe** is required.
 
• King Suraj Pal of the Tomar dynasty built the historic reservoir named Surajkund, also known as the "Lake of the Sun", in the** 10th century.**
